item.title: When to Stay and When to Go: The Evacuation Decision
item.description: The hardest call in the backcountry is rarely the treatment. It is deciding whether to walk out, wait, or call for help.
item.content:encoded:
The hardest call in the backcountry is rarely the treatment. It is deciding whether to walk out, wait, or call for help.

In this placeholder episode we talk through how experienced trip leaders frame that decision.

In this episode

  • Sorting problems into "getting better", "staying the same" and "getting worse"
  • What a rescue team needs to hear from you
  • Why the plan you made at home matters most
